name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: A long form walked one step at a time. Without JavaScript every step is a visible fieldset with one submit. With it, Back and Next, focus on each step's legend, progress in words, and nothing typed ever lost. Quiet is numbered stations; warm is a walk on a survey map, the road found round the hills with A*; playful adds footprints.

budget.reason: Behaviour about 11.7 KB (stepper.js 6.0 KB, stepper.core.js 5.6 KB with the terrain, A* and footprints); skins 1.2 KB (quiet), 4.5 KB of map shared by warm and playful (skins/map.js), 0.3 KB each for warm and playful. Total 17,973 bytes; declared at 20,480 for about 12% headroom (review W2 P12, as Wave 1 P7 asked), within decision 0009.
